verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents a concrete rate limit for the Team plan (400 req/min), and a limits page tells users to split oversized documents with page_range. Webhooks support async job completion without polling. For "extremely high volume", Datalab points to paid on-prem deployment with a Helm chart for Kubernetes, which means million-page scale may require an Enterprise contract and self-hosting rather than the hosted API. Missing for 10: documented throughput or latency figures (pages/sec, SLA), a dedicated batch submission endpoint, rate limits for other tiers, and independent evidence of predictable performance at millions of pages.
